raw_text: This is massive. Hamas has launched the biggest attack on Israel in decades. Videos from multiple settlements showing armed fighters going house to house. Paragliders used to bypass the border fence. Rocket barrages overwhelming Iron Dome. Reports of a music festival being attacked with mass casualties. The IDF is mobilizing reserves.
